scripts.deploy:dev: bash -c 'set -a && . .env.local && set +a && export STAGE=dev && bash scripts/build-layer.sh && [ -f .ffmpeg-layer-arn ] || bash scripts/build-ffmpeg-layer.sh && serverless deploy --stage dev'
scripts.deploy:demo: bash -c 'set -a && . .env.local && set +a && export STAGE=demo && bash scripts/build-layer.sh && [ -f .ffmpeg-layer-arn ] || bash scripts/build-ffmpeg-layer.sh && serverless deploy --stage demo'
scripts.deploy:prod: bash -c 'set -a && . .env.prod.local && set +a && export STAGE=prod && bash scripts/build-layer.sh && [ -f .ffmpeg-layer-arn ] || bash scripts/build-ffmpeg-layer.sh && serverless deploy --stage prod'
